name: Why is AEO important for my general contracting business?

mainEntity.name: Why is AEO important for my general contracting business?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO is crucial because it directly influences your online visibility and credibility. In a competitive market, search engines prioritize businesses that demonstrate genuine expertise and trustworthiness. Achieving strong AEO helps your website rank higher in search results, attracting more potential clients looking for reliable contractors. This leads to increased organic traffic, more qualified leads, and ultimately, business growth by establishing your company as a leader in the general contracting field.
